pedido: Short: Roy Sullivan: The Man Struck by Lightning 7 Times (US park ranger, Guinness record). Told in action and second person from second 0 ('Strike number one: you're up a fire tower'), name later, no bio card or repeated question. 50-60s, end on the record fact and cut.

videos.title: Roy Sullivan: Struck by Lightning 7 Times #shorts
videos.description:
Would you ever go outside in a storm again? 👇

Roy Sullivan, the park ranger struck by lightning 7 times and still alive: the true story behind the Guinness World Record.
He survived seven strikes between 1942 and 1977 in Shenandoah National Park, and even fought off a bear.
